[channel D_EXAMPLE — full reply how-to, sent once per channel per adapter session]
To reply: write your reply to a file, then run:
  gc slack reply-current --conversation-id D_EXAMPLE --reply-to <ts> --body-file <file>
--reply-to <ts> replies in that message's thread; a top-level message's own ts starts its thread. --no-thread forces a top-level post.
To react: gc slack react --emoji <name>
